settings.heading: Area rugs & layers
settings.text: Find a starting point in texture, colour and proportion. We help you consider a rug's scale and placement, and how it connects with your furniture and art.
settings.image_alt: Interior inspiration with an area rug grounding a softly layered bedroom

settings.heading: Art & object placement
settings.text: Give the pieces you love room to be seen. Explore where a painting, sculpture or collectible can sit, and how it works with the light and objects around it.
settings.image_alt: Artwork displayed on a wall at The Raw House gallery

settings.heading: Homes & occasions
settings.text: Bring a fresh feeling to an everyday room or a special gathering. Consider art, textiles and objects together, with attention to the setting and the people it is for.
settings.image_alt: Interior inspiration with flowers, candles and objects arranged in a gathering space

settings.heading: Share your starting point
settings.text: Tell us about your room or occasion, the pieces you own, and what you would like to change. Measurements, references and a budget can help guide the conversation.

settings.heading: Explore what belongs
settings.text: Discuss rugs, art and objects in relation to your space. We consider the mood, palette and proportions, as well as the pieces you are drawn to.

settings.heading: Bring the details together
settings.text: Talk through placement, combinations and the finishing touches. The scope and next steps are shaped around your particular space or occasion.

settings.heading: A space that feels
settings.intro: From the rug beneath your feet to the art on your walls, we help bring pieces together for your home, your occasion, and the way you live.
settings.hero_alt: Interior inspiration with layered rugs, art and sculptural objects
settings.hero_caption: A study in art, texture & proportion.
settings.services_heading: Thoughtful details. A whole new feeling.
settings.services_intro: A single piece can change a room. The right conversation between pieces can make it yours.
settings.story_alt: Interior inspiration with an area rug, artwork and a considered arrangement of furniture
settings.story_heading: The piece you love is just the beginning.
settings.story_body:
Perhaps a painting caught your eye. Perhaps you already own a sculpture, or want to find a rug that brings a room together.

We help you consider scale, colour, texture and placement, working with the pieces you have and the ones you are drawn to. The aim is a space that feels personal, comfortable and complete.
settings.story_note: For a room you live in every day. For a moment you want to make special.
settings.process_intro: You do not need a finished plan. A room, a favourite piece, or an occasion is enough to begin.

settings.heading: What would you like to bring together?
settings.intro: Tell us a little about your home, the piece you have in mind, or the occasion you are planning. We can explore the styling possibilities with you.
settings.note: Already found something at The Raw House? Include its name or link in your enquiry.
